ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: I chose Lapwing because the query is a lightweight, neutral request—giving a real-world example for a straightforward statement. It doesn't need Willet's superior performance on hard reasoning/knowledge benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA), so that capability edge is irrelevant here. Meanwhile, the task fits Lapwing's well-served families (neutral transactional requests scored 53), and its Creative Generation eval (82.7) is statistically tied with Willet's, meaning no quality loss. Routing easy tasks to Lapwing reserves Willet's strengths for queries that actually benefit from them.
